author: Epic Games
description:
After 13+ years of slicing and dicing through the Origin System, Warframe's original swordsman brings his mastery of the blade to the world of Fortnite! 

For the first time, Tenno can squad up, drop into the Island, and outrun the storm as the legendary Excalibur.  

Beginning at 7 p.m. ET on July 11, you'll get the Excalibur Outfit as a FREE gift-with-purchase when you complete an eligible Warframe transaction through the Epic Games Store. You can also nab one through Fortnite's in-game Item Shop using V-Bucks, starting at 8 p.m ET.  For a full list of eligible purchase items, visit: https://epic.gm/warframe-faq
title: TennoCon 2026 | Play as Excalibur in Fortnite - Available Now!
